title: A field trial with an exception

rows.name: AI-Radar
rows.notes: Two Kansas fields, no randomized treatment assignment. Satellite-derived water deficit index; lower means lower inferred water stress. Source-reported descriptive SD; aggregation over pixels, dates or both and sample count are not specified in the extracted table. Not a confidence interval or independent field replication.

geography.unit: Two corn fields at a central Kansas farm; no national extrapolation
geography.definition: Two corn fields at a central Kansas farm; no national extrapolation
geography.anchorRule: Use an explicitly non-geographic sphere or global band. No national fill, fake city locations, or inferred unobserved distribution.

time.updateCadence: Frozen research snapshot; recheck source before any update, not a live feed

sources.publisher: Debangshi et al., Agricultural & Environmental Letters
sources.title: Precision irrigation with artificial intelligence–integrated ground-penetrating radar reduces water stress in corn
sources.locator: Table 1; Methods field comparison; Results limitations

reuse.basis: Limited extraction of factual findings; source prose, figures, maps and raw restricted records are not redistributed
reuse.attribution: Precision irrigation with artificial intelligence–integrated ground-penetrating radar reduces water stress in corn — Debangshi et al., Agricultural & Environmental Letters
reuse.notes: No open-data licence is asserted. Only a small, separately structured factual summary is included; full-source republication is outside this pack.

coverage.population: Two corn fields at a central Kansas farm; no national extrapolation
coverage.included: 8 populated records; inclusion is defined by the exact source locator in every row
coverage.omitted: No global water savings, randomized causal estimate, measured crop-yield gain, fertilizer reduction or cross-climate transfer test
coverage.missingness: Unobserved or unpublished is not zero; omitted places/classes have no inferred values.

uncertainty: Different irrigation hardware and management co-vary with AI use. WDI relies on satellite NDVI and evapotranspiration modelling, not direct field evapotranspiration measurements. In 2023 vegetative-stage WDI is higher in the AI field; retain this exception. Published p threshold 0.1 and descriptive SDs do not cure lack of field replication; the SD aggregation and sample count are not specified in the extracted table.

transform.description: Transcribed selected published factual findings into a normalized long table; values retain source precision. No interpolation or score normalization.
transform.validation: Row-level source locators; numerical bounds and schema checked locally; independent review pending.

verification.method: Primary publication/table read and values transcribed, with comparison to source metadata; independent acceptance pending.

scoring.reason: No defensible common 1–100 extremity construct. Display source metric and uncertainty in original units.

forecast.reason: No original future extrapolation; any model evaluations are retrospective results only.
